facilityType: Skilled Nursing Facility and Rehabilitation Center
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader dedicated to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations. You will play a critical role in maintaining high standards of quality care, operational efficiency, and financial performance, while promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business management, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care facilities.
Strong leadership, financial management, and interpersonal communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, compensation based on experience.
